name: VRM_REVENUE_OPTIONS_ALL
description: VRM_REVENUE_OPTIONS_ALL contains the processing options that are used in the revenue recognition and revenue compliance processes in the Revenue Management application.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ACT_DATE_IN_CLOSED_PERIOD
columns.description: The system option that indicates how the system should handle imported transaction lines with the accounting date in a closed period. Possible values are Yes and No.

columns.name: CREATE_CLEARING_OPTION
columns.description: The system option that indicates whether or not the clearing accounting entries need to be created.

columns.name: CLEARING_ACCOUNT
columns.description: Clearing Account to be used for imported transactions that need accounting entries to be created.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MEA_CLEARING_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT
columns.description: Clearing Account to be used to record MEA adjustment entries.

columns.name: REV_CLEARING_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT
columns.description: Clearing Account to be used to record revenue entries.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
